[[File:Vital_Strike_SoC.jpg|thumb|right|250px|A Rebel officer pointing Group Alpha during a briefing.]]
'''Group Alpha''' was a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] naval unit. The unit was shown on a [[Hologram/Legends|holographic]] display onboard a [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Mon Calamari Star Cruiser/Legends|Star Cruiser]], where it was pitted against an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] naval unit led by the [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Devastator/Legends|''Devastator'']].
